prompt: Translate the virtual address `0x605ABC` with 4 KiB pages. Give the index used at each level and the offset.
explain: 0x605ABC is 0b110_0000_0101_1010_1011_1100. Bits 0-11 are the offset 0xABC. The next nine bits (12-20) are 0x005, the page-table index; the nine above those (21-29) give 3. Bits 30 and up are zero, so the PML4 and PDPT indices are 0.
